agent.countingHint: In-app Agent counts chat, confirmation and cancellation requests. Agent API counts requests; MCP counts tool calls. Internal Agent tools are counted separately and are not added to total calls. MCP initialization, pings and tool listings are excluded. Success rate measures request or tool success, not answer quality.
agent.historyHint: Tracking starts with this upgrade; earlier calls cannot be reconstructed. Only call type, outcome and duration are stored, without conversations, arguments, keys or response content.
